question: After finishing Arc 8 and 9, I'd like to know which stories gave you a great sense of accomplishment and satisfaction once you finished writing them, and which ones left you feeling sad that they were finally over.
answer:
The ending of Arc 8—the end of the Vollachia Arc—is also the end of her (Priscilla) life, so when I wrote that, I felt an enormous sense of loss. I had already decided on the plot, but the closer I got to it, the more I felt, “This is getting really difficult...” My feelings just sank lower and lower.

At the same time, I couldn't do a half-hearted job of it, so I agonized over it a lot. I think I wrote it while feeling things like, “Is this really okay? Is it really okay to put this out there? Did I really give everything I had to this?” Once I finished it, rather than a sense of accomplishment, the ending of Chapter 8 left me feeling like a part of my soul had gone missing, or something like that.

On the other hand, when it comes to Arc 9, I felt like, “I finally got to say what I'd been keeping quiet about!” (laughs) Of course, it was something I'd decided on more than ten years ago, so it was like, “I finally got to reveal the thing I've really been wanting to say!” It felt really good.

I remember updating the chapter about an hour before the signing event (MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2025), and having fun watching everyone who came to the signing event make faces like, “Whoa...” (laughs).
